note: Hand-derived from CodeInterprocEvidenceUpsertCypher (go/internal/storage/cypher/edge/writer/code_interproc_evidence.go): `UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (s:Function {uid: row.source_function_uid}) MATCH (t:Function {uid: row.sink_function_uid}) MERGE (s)-[rel:TAINT_FLOWS_TO {evidence_uid: row.uid}]->(t) SET ...`, NOT from the port or family name. TAINT_FLOWS_TO is the only type this writer can emit (static token in the template, kept out of any per-row substitution). Each endpoint is the live Function node uid the entities phase stamps for the finding's function: content.CanonicalEntityID over the owning repository, relative path, Function label inputs, and start line (Function is in canonicalNamePathLineEntityLabels, so the projector ignores any schematic incoming id and the findings must carry the recomputed ids -- the fixture's authenticate/chargeCard/parseQuery/runQuery functions resolve to their content-entity:e_* hashes, the same construction the node-substrate content_entity facts carry). The identity pin is the row uid taint.codeInterprocEvidenceUID derives as facts.StableID over source_function_uid, sink_function_uid, sink_kind, and source_kind (the MERGE keys on endpoints plus evidence_uid, so the fixture declares exactly that identity -- any other identity shape fails LoadExpectedEdges against the family's registration). Exactly two edges: the credential to payment-capture flow from authenticate to chargeCard, and the http-request to search-exec flow from parseQuery to runQuery (the cloud-boundary finding carrying the two-step why-trail). The tombstoned legacy finding contributes nothing on purpose -- the extractor skips tombstones before decoding, so a deleted flow reaches neither the rows nor the quarantine count. sink_kind and source_kind ride as Properties pins (the template SETs them as plain strings from the row); scope_id, generation_id, and evidence_source are writer-stamped per run and cannot be pinned statically.
